laws.rule: Nyika National Park: the protected-area regulations published on the Malawi Trade Portal bar entry after 16:00 and before 06:00 unless the Chief Parks and Wildlife Officer or Wildlife Officer gives written permission. The portions of the M9 (Mphora-Kaperekezi) and S103 (Chilinda turn-off to Kasaramba) within the park are closed to vehicle driving from 18:00 to 06:00 under the same written-permission exception.

sources.title: Malawi National Parks and Wildlife Act with protected-area regulations

sources.supports: Read directly: published protected-area regulations, especially regulation 6(k) to (m) Nyika/Nkhotakota hours and roads and 6(b)/(c) Liwonde/Lake Malawi exceptions. Later revisions not established by this page.
